name: DispatchBridge
heading: A webhook is the start, not the finish.
description: Validate a synthetic field-service job, deliver it to a mock CRM API, and inspect retries, idempotency and failure handling.
label: Webhook payload (JSON)
sample:
Call event: call-101
Caller: This is Synthetic Customer. My kitchen sink is leaking and I need a plumber.
Dispatcher: What is the service ZIP code?
Caller: 10012.
Dispatcher: Which appointment would you prefer?
Caller: November 2, 2026 at 10:00 UTC (2026-11-02T10:00:00Z).
notice: Real HTTP requests to a deliberately failing mock CRM endpoint. Browser-local idempotency ledger; no durable server storage, ServiceTitan connection, real jobs or customer data.
